design.motivation: Earlier seed0 diagnostic showed a prolonged generalization gap at low shrinkage; confirm on unseen seeds.
design.weight_decay_rule: weight_decay = target_eta_lambda / learning_rate for every candidate
design.selection_rule: val95 success, earliest 3-checkpoint val95 start, higher mean val accuracy over last 2000 steps, higher final val accuracy, lower learning rate
design.primary_outcome: val95 success rate by 10000 steps; first 3-checkpoint val95 starting step among successes, with failures censored
design.scope: Confirmation within a regime chosen from earlier exploratory diagnostics, not a universal optimizer ranking. Selection uses seed7 only; seeds4/5/6 are not used for selection.
design.timing: One idle A100 GPU0; serial runs; alternate confirmation optimizer order by seed.
